source.description_exact: Every “WHERE IS THIS FROM?” moment is a missed sale — unless your automation’s on it. Catch ‘em while the vibes are hot
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Send offers in DMs during Live
Business value
Live shopping isn’t just for the QVC crowd. With this setup, you turn attention into transactions. Every time someone comments during your stream, they get instant access to what you’re selling — no awkward “check my link in bio” delays.
How does it work?

While you’re doing your thing on IG Live, ask viewers to comment a specific word like “BUY” or “ME.” That triggers an automation that slides into their DMs with a product link, coupon, or personalized offer. You stay focused on the live show, and your automation handles the sales floor behind the scenes.

graph_integrity.limitation: Original graph is not exposed. Draft edges use visible navigation identity; no hidden IDs or server export.

json_exact.reason: Unsaved-trigger leave dialog prevented initial navigation. Mismatched trigger capture excluded.

selection.choose_when: Use a Live keyword, opening button and one coupon offer.
selection.avoid_when: The claimed 24-hour expiry is not implemented by a timer node.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
All existing node defaults were opened. Shared options are evidence-matched; exhaustive alternative node-type conversion is not proven.
